name: Simple Noclip
description: Toggleable noclip with a bindable key, optional safe mode and an on-screen NOCLIP label.

noclip-keybind.name: Toggle Noclip Key
noclip-keybind.description: Press this key to turn noclip on or off. Click the keybind button to change it.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: When ON, no progress is saved for any attempt where noclip was used (no completion, no best percentage). Turn OFF to let the game save progress normally while noclip is on.

toggle-notification.name: Show Toggle Popup
toggle-notification.description: Show a small popup when noclip is switched on or off during a level.

label-enabled.name: Show Label
label-enabled.description: Show a small NOCLIP label at the bottom of the screen while noclip is on.

label-position.name: Position
label-position.description: Where along the bottom of the screen the label sits.

label-y-offset.name: Height From Bottom
label-y-offset.description: Distance from the bottom edge of the screen, in pixels.
